title: Israeli airstrike hits camp in Gaza's Deir Al-Balah
description:
Video shows the moment an airstrike hitting tents in a camp in Gaza, sparking a fire and sending plumes of smoke into the sky.
Subscribe  ► https://www.youtube.com/user/guardianwires?sub_confirmation=1

At least one person was killed and several others were injured when an Israeli strike hit the Deir Al-Balah camp.

Witnesses told the Associated Press that they had received warning calls from apparent Israeli military personnel prior to the strike, asking them to evacuate and move to some 500 meters away from the tent camp.

Gaza’s health ministry says that at least 680 people have been ⁠killed by Israeli fire since the October ceasefire. Israel said four soldiers were killed by militants in Gaza in the same period.
